jobs.occupation: Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering Data Centres
jobs.description:
As a Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, you coordinate the entire engineering and design process. You monitor the technical scope, planning and engineering budget, ensuring that the different disciplines work together towards one integrated design.

• Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams within complex data centre projects

• Manage the technical scope, engineering budget and associated contract documentation

• Prepare and monitor the engineering schedule and allocate tasks within the team

• Coordinate the different technical disciplines and ensure alignment between their designs

• Coordinate collaboration between Belgian and international engineering teams

• Work closely with external consultants, contractors and other technical partners

• Review technical design decisions and challenge or adjust them where necessary

• Manage design changes and assess their impact on the overall project

• Translate complex client requirements into technically feasible solutions

• Present and discuss technical concepts with clients and project teams

• Remain involved during the execution phase and act as a technical point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders

For the position of Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, we are looking for someone who combines strong technical knowledge with excellent coordination skills. Experience within data centres is an advantage, but experience with industrial buildings or other technically complex building projects can also be a strong match.

• You hold a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical discipline

• You have at least 5 years of experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects

• You have experience leading and coordinating engineers and other technical stakeholders

• You are familiar with complex technical building installations and multidisciplinary engineering

• Experience with data centres, industrial buildings or other complex built environments is a strong advantage

• You are familiar with digital engineering processes, 3D design and BIM environments

• You have a good understanding of relevant standards, regulations and working methods within engineering and construction

• You communicate effectively with engineers, consultants, contractors and clients

• English knowledge is a must, Dutch and French are a plus

Relevant experience is essential for this position. We are specifically looking for candidates who have previously worked in a similar role, coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects within data centres, industrial buildings or other technically complex environments.

If you do not have relevant experience in a comparable position or project environment, we kindly ask you not to apply for this vacancy.

LVO Industries is a permanent capital holding company. We acquire family-owned and owner-operated businesses and partner with them to ensure their long-term success. At LVO, you’ll join a small, dynamic team operating in an entrepreneurial environment.
 

Role & Responsibilities :As CTO, you are the digital control tower of the LVO group, responsible for the digital aspects of every portfolio company: Odoo, AI, software development and the Microsoft stack. You bring strong engineering and real AI expertise, set the standards, and make sure the right technology choices and practices are followed everywhere. The job is as much about coaching the teams as building IT solutions yourself in Odoo, AI and beyond. Your responsibilities will evolve over time, and will at least include:
 
 

• make sure all digital tools (Odoo, AI agents, the Microsoft stack, other third-party software) are well chosen and used to their full potential across teams. 

• ensure the IT teams are highly efficient and well-functioning, coaching them on engineering and AI best practices, code quality and testing. 

• drive the development of AI agents to accelerate automation, improve customer satisfaction and replace costly tools, building them yourself and enabling the POs and IT teams to build and run them. 

• implement, follow up and continuously optimize Odoo across the portfolio companies. 

• oversee the broader technical foundation: hosting, architecture, cybersecurity, testing and data. 

• help select external providers and partners, and make sure they deliver.  

Success means a digital strategy that performs across the group: strong automation, a better experience for staff and customers, solid cybersecurity, and technology that is future-proof and cost-effective.

Mindset :More than anything else, we are looking for a candidate with a positive attitude, who is:
 
 

• a builder who codes and configures as naturally as they advise 

• a teacher at heart who leaves teams stronger than they found them 

• obsessed with using AI and automation to remove friction 

• comfortable carrying influence without a title to back it up 

• self-starting, pragmatic, allergic to needless process 

• at ease jumping between companies, stacks and roles 

• dependable: says what they'll do, then does it  

Requirements :
 
 

• a genuine developer and IT engineer background (degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent): you have built and shipped software yourself, stay hands-on with code, and are comfortable across the stack from application architecture to hosting, cybersecurity and automated testing 

• between 5 and 10 years implementing IT and automation projects, including ERP set-ups, in small and medium-sized businesses. 

• real depth in AI: hands-on experience designing and deploying AI-based solutions, and a clear view on applying AI best practices in a business context 

• able to be based in Brussels (Watermael-Boitsfort) and to travel within Belgium. 

• strong written and verbal communication skills in Dutch, French and English

The Field Service Technician is responsible for carrying out services and maintenance at Customer Installations and where applicable as well for assembly and dismantling. 
Will maintain, repair and perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance of Air Liquide installations (PG,Cryo, bulk & On Sites) and equipment at customer sites within the assigned budget. 
He/She executes the maintenance work according to procedures and standards. After each work execution, the technician manages his intervention report signed by the customers and communicates with the Maintenance Planner to ensure quality and integrity of the data. 
Provide On-site support for testing, and troubleshooting. 
He/she provides a high level of quality of service to customers in the assigned area and ensures legal and IMS compliance. 
He/she implements the environmental legislation, works in line with the ISO 14001 standard, , respects the good environmental practices and shows a positive attitude with regard to the preservation of the environment 

 

Performs preventive & corrective maintenance
 
 

• Executes preventive maintenance according to planning, with sub-contractor if required. 

• Performs the all kind of maintenance work on PG, Bulk & On Sites according procedure and standard 

• Contact the maintenance planners if corrective maintenance is required. 

• Prepares reports and obtains the customer signature on maintenance intervention report. 

• Confirms data in SAP (kilometers-time-spare parts used-cause of failure...)  

 
 

Repairs and troubleshooting of equipment failures
 
 

• The FST will execute the intervention once the work is confirmed by the maintenance planner and spare parts are available. 

• Will analyzes and identifies malfunctions as well determines the necessary repairs, and carries them out (with subcontractor if applicable). 

• Will communicate the spare parts used and obtain the intervention report signed by the customer.  

 
 

Ensures all quality & safety procedures are followed
 
 

• Understands and adheres to all relevant IMS procedures within the scope of their qualifications 

• Ensures Compliances and applies IMS and legal rules. 

• Knows and respects the country SOPs and standards 

•    

Reports accurate and up-to-date maintenance information
 
 

• Communicates with the Maintenance planner to ensure quality and integrity of the data. 

• Confirms completion of work after site visit 

• Writes consolidated reports on quality defects and customer complaints  

 
 

Communicates potential problems that may affect safety, reliability & quality
 
 

• Identifies through experience and troubleshooting analysis the dysfunctionment of gas equipments 

• Observes work area(s) and is alert to and avoids unsafe behaviors and conditions or other hazards 

• Participates in corrective measures when appropriate or authorized  

 
 

Face to face with the customers & internal sales force
 
 

• Communicates professionally and respectfully with customers. 

• Supports the project team with assembly and dismantling if applicable, as well as new or retrofit PG, Bulk, on Site, cryo or MGPS projects. 

• Respects and promotes the Zero safety incident goal 

• Ensure operational readiness of service vehicles, PPE, tools, and work equipment. 

• Participate in an on-call rotation to provide support outside of normal business hours 

Experience
 
 

• Good troubleshooting skills 

• Good understanding of operations & safety procedures 

• Capable to analyse trends, problems & cause-effects 

• Understanding of procedures and regulatory for new and existing industrial installations 

• Good knowledge maintenance activities 

• Technical understanding of gas physical and production processes 

• Good understanding of Safety procedures  

 
 

Competencies:
 

Hard skills:
 
 

• Language proficiency 

• Fluent in Dutch 

• Pre-intermediate English 

• Maintenance tools & methods (SAP) 

• IMS 

• Google tools 

• Telemetry applications 

• Mechanical and /or electrical and / or automation knowledge  

Soft skills : 
 
 

• Promoting and supporting actions towards Safety, Health and environment protection 

• Encourages questioning of established ideas and practices and ask why regularly and provide deliverables on time 

• Good communication with the different stakeholders 

• Customer mindset & team player 

• Team player 

• Striving for continuous improvement

About Us: 
 

Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative scale-up dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027.
 

 
 

Job Description & Key Responsibilities:
 

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented Production Technician to join our microbial production team. In this role, you will play a key part in producing beneficial microorganisms used in biostimulant, biocontrol, and biofertilizer products that support healthy crop growth. Training will be provided, so prior microbiology experience is not required — though it's a plus. Curiosity and attention to detail matter most.
 

 
 

Your tasks:
 
 

• You independently carry out production tasks according to standard procedures: you prepare supplies, sterilize, inoculate, harvest and handle downstream processing. 

• You work under sterile conditions and strictly follow hygiene and sterility protocols, giving contamination no chance. 

• You safeguard product quality at every stage by performing in-process quality and sterility checks. 

• You help with downstream processing and carry out quantification checks as part of the final quality control. 

• You actively contribute to continuous improvement (TPM) and help find solutions when problems arise. 

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• You have a technical or scientific background: a secondary school diploma, an associate degree (graduaat) or equivalent practical experience. 

• You enjoy steady, hands-on work and feel right at home in it. 

• You understand the basics of microbiology: you know what bacteria and fungi are and how contamination occurs, and you're interested in sterility and hygiene. 

• Repetitive tasks don't put you off: you stay focused and precise, even over long periods. 

• You can stand for extended periods and regularly lift and carry moderate loads without difficulty. 

• Have you worked with an ELN (Electronic Lab Notebook) before? That's a plus, but we'll train you either way. 

• You're responsible, reliable and a true team player, and safety and hygiene in the workplace come naturally to you. 

• You speak and write both Dutch and English fluently.

EN

What if the systems you engineer don’t just work on paper, but actually power, control, and bring real machines to life? At M-ECS, you’ll design and integrate the electrical and automation systems that make off-highway vehicles and other robotic platforms work as one. You’ll work at the intersection of electrical engineering, automation, embedded systems, and system integration, helping machines operate reliably in demanding industrial and heavy-field environments.You’ll see your work move from
 idea → concept → system → real-world impact. 
YOUR ROLE, YOUR IMPACT. As a hands-on 
System Engineer, with a strong focus on
 Electrical & Automation Engineering, you’ll help design, integrate, test, and optimize the systems that make complex machines work in the field.You’ll connect the dots across electrical, automation, software, hydraulics, and mechanical systems, turning individual components and subsystems into one reliable, functional machine.
Key responsibilities: 
 
 

• Concept & Solution Engineering: Work directly with customers to understand their needs and challenges, challenge requirements where needed, and (co-)create technical solutions and system architectures that best addresses the problem. 

• Electrical Engineering: Design and integrate electrical architectures, components, wiring, sensors, actuators, and communication systems for off-highway vehicles and other machines. 

• Software, Automation & Controls: Program machine functions and control logic using PLCs, ECUs, and embedded systems. Integrate and commission control systems. 

• System Engineering: Connect electrical, software, hydraulic, and mechanical systems into a coherent and reliable machine architecture. Turn designs and ideas into functioning systems. 

• Testing & Commissioning: Build, integrate, commission, test, debug, and fine-tune prototypes and machines, turning concepts into reliable real-world solutions. 

• Customer Support, Training & Continuous Improvement: Support customers in the field or remotely, troubleshoot technical issues, provide hands-on training, and use customer and field feedback to continuously improve machine performance and reliability. 

ARE YOU THE ONE? You’re a
 hands-on Electrical Automation Engineer who enjoys understanding how things work, creating new solutions, and finding ways to make systems work even better. You don’t stop at the drawing board. You enjoy building, programming, testing, debugging, and improving real machines and you’re curious about what happens when your engineering meets the real world. You like digging into complex problems and don’t stop until you’ve turned your understanding into a practical and efficient solution, especially when there’s no obvious answer or manual to follow.
You approach challenges from a systems perspective, combining analytical thinking, creativity, and practical problem-solving. You’re curious, eager to learn, adaptable, and comfortable working both independently and as part of a team. Most importantly, you thrive in a fast-paced and ambitious environment where you can tackle complex technical challenges and see your solutions work reliably in the field.
 
 

• A 
master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Electromechanics, Mechatronics, Systems Engineering, or a related field. 

• Approximately 
3–5 years of relevant experience in a similar engineering role, working with electrical systems, automation, controls, or embedded systems. 

• A strong interest in (off-highway vehicles), robotics, or intelligent machines. 

• Knowledge of 
PLC programming, preferably with CODESYS (Structured Text). 

• Knowledge of
 CAN-bus and/or other communication systems. 

• Strong knowledge of 
Eplan and electrical design. 

• Strong communication skills in 
Dutch and 
English. 

• Driver’s license B and a 
willingness to travel occasionally, both in Belgium and abroad.

Job introduction

When was the last time you translated a business need into a technical solution that could change an entire organization? That’s exactly what you’ll do with us!

As a Senior SAP Development Lead at delaware, you truly understand what businesses need and how we can deliver it. You’re eager to take the lead in transforming ideas into innovative solutions, guide customers through their move to SAP S/4 HANA, and add value to their business processes.

If development is in your DNA and you’re ready to take on a leading role, then you may be the Senior SAP Development Lead we’re looking for.

Who are we?

Did you know delaware is Belgium’s biggest SAP integrator? This means we get to work with the latest SAP technologies, such as all S/4 HANA deployments, SAP Fiori, SAP Cloud Platform services like ABAP Environment, iRPA, HANA Cloud, API Management, and the SAP Business Technology Platform. Enough with the name-dropping though — you probably already know your way around these technologies! And if you don’t, we’ll happily guide you through them .

We are the SAP Development team. We’re a fun-loving and ambitious team with a strong group dynamic. Even though there are more than 60 of us, we’re still a very tight-knit bunch! We love going for drinks together and we organize the best team events. It’s in our nature to coach our teammates: seniors happily share knowledge with newer members of the team (and vice versa). So what’s it like to work with us? ‘Unique,’ ‘adventurous,’ and ‘challenging’ are just three of the words team members have used to describe their experience. Read our stories here.

We have a broad spectrum of projects and customers in a wide variety of sectors and across the entire range of SAP modules. We also offshore development work to our colleagues in Harbin (China), but it’s up to the development lead to decide which tasks stay with us and which are sent to China.

Just so you know: delaware has offices in Antwerp, Ghent, Kortrijk, Lummen, Liège, and Wavre, but we also spend a lot of time working with our customers on-site. We also offer the flexibility to work from home.
